metadata.description: Android installer app that runs the real RuneLite client on Samsung Tab S10 Ultra via Termux + proot-distro
metadata.session_notes: Session 80: Shipped full per-phase GPU telemetry stack end-to-end in one rebuild cycle. rlawt A1-A8 (rlawt_nix.c + rlawt.h) — per-swap timing, inter-swap gap, XSync probe, lagged GPU timer-query ring, glFinish probe, window-summary p50/p95/max, capability probe block, env-gated fast-disabled path. Side-cars: perf-sampler.sh (/proc/$PID/task/* thread snapshots + Mali sysfs GPU-busy) + fps-log-tail.sh (FIFO-fd-persistent tail of client.log for FpsPlugin line extraction). Launcher wired with PID traps + GPU-busy DIAG probe. LaunchCoordinator.kt:180 late-edit added all five perf env flags to cmdLine. APK rebuilt 22:58, installed R52X90378YB. First-run readings at Varrock East Bank (GPU on, Uncapped, probes ON): FpsPlugin=31, gap_us mean≈18500 (54 FPS swap ceiling), swap_us≈15200, finish_us≈8000 (GPU busy 8ms after swap — GPU-bound), xsync_us≈250 (X IPC trivial), glerr=0, mkcur=0. Client thread cpus=0-3 (little cores, NOT /top-app — TermuxProcessPin not engaging on native path), Client ctxt-switch rate 1100/s vs S77 proot 3945/s (~4× reduction from native path). GL_ARB_timer_query UNAVAILABLE on virgl Mesa 25.2.8 (ext=0 ver=4.3) — finish_us is our only GPU-cost proxy on this driver. Filed 3 defects as issues #55 (stale-lock PID reuse), #56 (RESIZE_WINDOW invalid enum), #57 (GPU Hybrid + uiScale=2 sidebar scaling). Next: S81 probes-OFF A/B + re-engage big-core affinity on native path.

current_phase.phase_name: 120 FPS Presentation — Option B native-Termux JVM with GPU plugin active + full per-phase telemetry landed (S80). Next: close GPU-mode FPS gap via probes-off A/B + big-core pinning re-test on native path.

active_blockers.description: S80 telemetry landed. FpsPlugin 31 FPS at Varrock East Bank with probes ON (Uncapped, GPU on). rlawt gap_us=18500us = 54 FPS swap cadence; finish_us=8ms (GPU busy half the 60Hz budget — GPU-bound); xsync_us=250us (X IPC trivial); Client thread cpus=0-3 (little cores, not /top-app). Native path delivered ~4× reduction in Client ctxt-switch rate vs S77 proot-era. Two open vectors: (1) probe-overhead (~44% of frame time is glFinish+XSync diagnostic barriers) — need probes-OFF A/B to get clean GPU-on FPS reading; (2) big-core affinity — TermuxProcessPin from S75/S76 apparently isn't engaging on the native-Termux launch path, leaving JVM on /background or /moderate cpuset. GL_ARB_timer_query unavailable on virgl Mesa 25.2.8 so GPU-side per-stage breakdowns not possible without driver upgrade. S81 plan: probes-OFF first (edit LaunchCoordinator.kt:180 to drop FINISH/XSYNC/GPU_TIMER, rebuild, re-measure), then big-core re-engagement.

resolved_blockers.description: Session 78 surfaced: lwjgl-3.3.2-natives-linux-arm64.jar's embedded liblwjgl.so is glibc-linked, so RuneLite's GPU plugin fails dlopen under Bionic with (progressively): (a) cannot find libpthread.so.0/libc.so.6/libdl.so.2/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1 (DT_NEEDED glibc sonames); (b) cannot find X from verneed[0] in DT_NEEDED list (DT_VERNEED soname mismatch when symlink shim is tried); (c) cannot locate symbol stderr/snprintf/... (Bionic strict version mismatch against GLIBC_2.17); (d) cannot locate symbol __xstat64 (glibc-only, genuinely absent in Bionic).
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 79: patch-lwjgl-bionic.sh + libbionic-compat.c ship in-APK. Three layers: (1) patchelf --replace-needed rewrites all 4 glibc sonames in both DT_NEEDED and DT_VERNEED in one pass (empirically verified both sections update). (2) patchelf --clear-symbol-version on all 83 imported symbols that carried @GLIBC_2.17 — Bionic falls back to name-only lookup against its @@LIBC exports. (3) libbionic-compat.so (compiled on-device by Termux clang from asset-shipped libbionic-compat.c, ~5.8KB) exports the 4 glibc-only symbols as forwarders to Bionic equivalents: __errno_location → __errno; __xstat64(ver, path, buf) → stat(path, buf); __fxstat64 → fstat; __getdelim → getdelim. patchelf --add-needed libbionic-compat.so wires it in. Script is idempotent and runs on every launch. VERIFIED on R52X90378YB 2026-04-17 22:05 — 'Plugin GpuPlugin is now running' + 'Using device: virgl (Mali-G720-Immortalis MC12)' + 'Using driver: 4.3 (Compatibility Profile) Mesa 25.2.8' in runelite-native.log. Zero Error-starting-GPU events. First time GPU plugin has activated on the native Bionic path.

resolved_blockers.description: S78: Termux Mesa 26.0.5's client-side GLX query returned zero FBConfigs against Termux:X11. glxinfo -B, glxgears -info, and rlawt glXChooseFBConfig all failed identically. Proot-Ubuntu Mesa against same X server succeeded. Theorized to be the GPU plugin blocker.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 79: Turned out NOT to be the GPU plugin blocker. RL's GPU plugin uses rlawt's own fbconfig enumeration (per-db iteration with visualID matching) which DOES find visualID=33 against Termux Mesa successfully. glxinfo's failure was a Termux Mesa 26.0.5 client-lib quirk unrelated to the rendering pipeline. We downgraded to Mesa 25.2.8 as part of investigation (scripts/deploy-mesa25-to-device.sh + docs/build-notes/mesa-25-build-patches.md) but the actual GPU unblock was the LWJGL Bionic compat layer (see lwjgl-liblwjgl-glibc-linked-blocks-gpu-plugin).

resolved_blockers.description: S78: RL's ContainableFrame was 765x503 due to stored runelite.gameSize profile — wasted the rest of the canvas after immersive bars fix.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 79 tasks E1+E2: adaptive runelite.gameSize patch at native launch + stretched-mode scalingFactor=100 wired into launch-runelite-native.sh's RL-CONFIG step. Verify full-screen rendering on next session's launch now that GPU plugin activates.

resolved_blockers.description: S78: If Termux:X11 binder died after the activity had successfully attached once, HybridX11HostActivity had no escape — user was stuck on the diagnostic black screen with no way back to the RLT main screen to retry.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 79: added handleBinderDeathEscapeHatch() in HybridX11HostActivity.kt. After a prior successful attach, a 3s window of sustained binderAlive=false + lastEvent=binder_died triggers finish(), returning the user to the RLT main screen. Timeout cancels if binder recovers mid-wait. Single activity edit, no new files.

resolved_blockers.description: rlawt-1.8.jar shipped glibc-linked librlawt.so, incompatible with Termux Bionic linker.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 78 Task 21: rebuilt via Android NDK 28.2.13676358. librlawt.so Bionic-only NEEDED (libjawt.so libGL.so.1 libGLX.so.0 libX11.so libm.so libdl.so libc.so), SONAME librlawt.so, single VERNEED entry references libc.so Bionic LIBC (not glibc). 26 undefined symbols all verified present on device. Packaged as rlawt-1.8-bionic.jar. Verified via MiniRlawtLoad + MiniAwtContext + full RL launch.

resolved_blockers.description: Proot ptrace interception limited Client thread to ~2000 syscalls/s → 12 FPS ceiling.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 78 Phase 2.1+2.2: launch-runelite-native.sh + Kotlin LaunchPreferences.useNativeTermux bypass proot entirely. JVM runs under Termux openjdk-21 directly; no proot in process tree. Classpath regenerated live from repository2/; Bionic rlawt jar swapped in via ScriptManager.deployJars() (APK unzip, 141ms). End-to-end native-path RL launch verified on R52X90378YB; Robey Wan character logged in.

resolved_blockers.description: Session 72+ bug: ScriptManager.scriptsDeployedGlobal @Volatile flag prevented re-deploy on APK update, stranding asset fixes on-host.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 78 Phase 2.2: replaced global bool with per-APK-version marker at $HOME/.rlt/deployed-version compared to BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE. ensureMarkerChecked() invalidates in-memory cache on VERSION_CODE change; maybeWriteVersionMarker() writes fresh marker only after ALL three deploys (scripts/configs/jars) succeed for current version.

resolved_blockers.description: S74 theorized Samsung OneUI's /background cpuset (CPUs 0-3) was clamping Termux subtree and thus FPS. S75-S76 landed Path A (bindService hoist to /top-app) with perfect scheduler landing (JVM+virgl on cpus 4-7). S76 measured FPS at 12-15 (vs 13 baseline). Scene FPS did not move. S77 /proc sampler showed system is 70%+ idle — pipeline is not CPU-bound. Cpuset was never the gate.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 76: Path A measured null. Session 77: /proc sampler confirmed sink is proot ptrace (3945 nonvol/s on Client), not CPU contention.

resolved_blockers.description: Originally 'per-PutImage-strip overhead'. Reframed in S74: compositor has 2.5x idle headroom, real bottleneck is upstream. Reframed again in S77: the real sink is proot ptrace interception of JVM syscalls.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 77: Bottleneck definitively identified as proot ptrace syscall interception. Tracked now as proot-ptrace-syscall-interception-caps-fps-at-12.

resolved_blockers.description: DamageTraceV2 proved the hot steady-state path is PutImage on WINDOW with backend=other, not fbPutImage or miPutImage.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 72: extended DamageTraceV2 with dladdr offset logging and routed through __android_log_print. addr2line resolved the unknown backend to `exaPutImage` @ xserver/exa/exa_accel.c:252, and exaComposite @ xserver/exa/exa_render.c:887. Both sit inside the EXA acceleration framework. Follow-on Slice 3 fix (lorieUploadToScreen) made the path 99.6% accelerated.

resolved_blockers.description: Session 70 concluded VirGL vtest socket serialization was the structural FPS ceiling (17-28ms inter-frame).
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 72 REFUTED this. VirGL throughput was never the bottleneck. S77 also confirmed — virgl main thread vol_rate 270/s matches current FPS × msg/frame, not elevated.

resolved_blockers.description: All clean architecture changes need verification on Samsung Tab S10 Ultra.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 69: Full end-to-end verification on R52X90378YB. Boot → setup → auth → launch → rendering all pass. All logging layers verified.

resolved_blockers.description: Zero tests, god classes >500 LoC, tight Android coupling, global mutable singletons, no CI.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 64-65: 180 tests, domain layer with zero Android imports, DI container (7 modules), all god classes ≤200 LoC, singletons eliminated, CoroutineDispatcher injected everywhere, CI pipeline active.

resolved_blockers.description: The 120 FPS investigation initially rebuilt and reinstalled only third_party/termux-x11-upstream :app, while the validated internal-hybrid path was actually using libXlorie.so packaged inside com.runelitetablet.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 62: Added XlorieIdentity logs, proved runtime identity, switched correct build/install loop.
